theme.theme_switch_strategy: Light mode default for academic/school software and printable report card clarity; Dark mode supported for back-office dashboard
theme.rationale: MA Nurul Qur'an Kebonagung is an Islamic Senior High School (Madrasah Aliyah). The visual identity combines distinguished Islamic academic heritage (Emerald Deep Forest Green, warm Sand/Parchment neutrals, Warm Amber/Ochre accents, Crisp White printable sheets) with crisp modern back-office ergonomics.

grade_entry_matrix.description: Fast excel-like batch grade editor with Tab/Enter keyboard navigation, inline validation (0-100), automated letter grade calculation (A: 90-100, B: 80-89, C: 70-79, D: <70), and auto-save indicator
features: Quick Fill / Import Sample Data button
Calculated columns: Rata-rata, Predikat, Status KKM (Tuntas / Belum Tuntas)
Batch export to Excel / Print preview
Instant Save button with Sonner notification

promotion_wizard.description: Multi-step promotion system for Waka Kurikulum to safely promote classes 10->11, 11->12, and 12->Lulus/Alumni
features: Preview per-student eligibility badge (Lolos / Bersyarat / Tinggal Kelas)
Mass Select checkbox with 'Naikkan Semua yang Tuntas' action
Direct archiving of Grade 12 to Alumni Register with graduation year & destination tracking
Rollback / Audit log protection against accidental promotion

password_manager_modal.description: Teacher & Student credential manager allowing Admin to view plain/hashed passwords, generate secure PINs, and trigger instant password reset with copy-to-clipboard

accessibility_and_compliance.color_contrast: All text and interactive icons exceed 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG AA contrast against their respective parent surface backgrounds
accessibility_and_compliance.keyboard_nav: Full arrow and tab navigation on grade input table rows and modal dialogs
accessibility_and_compliance.screen_reader: Aria labels provided for icon-only action buttons (edit, delete, reset password, print)

instructions_to_main_agent: Language is strictly Bahasa Indonesia across all UI labels, table headers, toasts, and printable reports.

Implement clear role-based switching: Admin (Waka Kurikulum), Guru Mapel (Subject Teacher), and Wali Kelas (Homeroom Teacher). When logged in as a teacher who is also assigned as Wali Kelas, ensure the 'Wali Kelas' menu section is visible; if not assigned as Wali Kelas, hide that menu section.

Include a prominent quick-demo switch bar or quick-login buttons on the login page for: 1. Waka Kurikulum (Admin), 2. Guru Mapel (Drs. Ahmad Fauzi - Fisika), 3. Wali Kelas (Siti Nurhaliza, S.Pd - Wali Kelas X-IPA 1).

Seed rich and realistic Indonesian Islamic Madrasah data: Subjects (PAI: Al-Qur'an Hadits, Aqidah Akhlak, Fiqih, SKI, Bahasa Arab; Umum: Matematika, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Inggris, Fisika, Biologi, Kimia, Ekonomi, Geografi, dll).

Ensure the printable report card (Rapor) follows the exact user requirement: clean white sheet with subtle watermark of 'MA Nurul Qur'an Kebonagung', school letterhead (Kop Surat Yayasan PP Nurul Qur'an), student metadata, grade matrix with NTS, NAS, Predikat, KKM, Attendance (S/I/A), Extracurriculars, Wali Kelas notes, Promotion statement (Naik/Tinggal/Lulus), and 3 signature blocks (Kepala Madrasah, Wali Kelas, Orang Tua).
Include standard `@base-ui/react` and `lucide-react` components from template. Add `react-to-print` or clean `@media print` CSS utility for 1-click seamless browser printing.
Always place `data-testid` on all key interactive elements as specified in test_id_conventions.
